Commentary.Commentary: Right then! We have had a perfect start to cricket in New Zealand. Rain, Batters going hammer and tongs, bowlers fighting it out. New Zealand have a huge task in hand after the rain played spoilsport. Can their batters come out and start the explosion? Or will West Indies come firing with the ball out there? Stay tuned with the chase on the other side of the break.

New Zealand's bowling was not so good barring Lockie Ferguson. The one man for them who lifted their spirits after the initial carnage was Lockie Ferguson. The man who ripped West Indies apart first with a couple of wickets and then came back to snare another three to make it 5 wickets for the evening. Tim Southee was the other one to get into the wickets column as he took a couple too. Rest all the bowlers took a beating. Kyle Jamieson had a poor debut game while Bennett was taken to the cleaners. In the end, the bowlers being rusty cost New Zealand dearly.

An innings of three parts one should say. After putting in West Indies to bat after winning the toss, Southee did a thing wrong as West Indies showed their intentions from ball one. After a small rain delay, the carnage continued from West Indies before New Zealand went full throttle at the West Indies batters. From 57/0, West Indies' Scoreboard read 59/5. Once again a stoppage meant that the game was reduced to 16 overs per side. Some powerful hitting from Allen and Pollard ensured that West Indies finish strongly though Allen departed, Pollard ensured that he stays till the end to see of the innings with a bang bringing up his fifty too in the process.

A dropped catch to end the innings! Short delivery on middle, Pollard pulls it uppishly towards mid-wicket where Glenn Phillips runs ahead to take the catch but fails to hold on. The batsmen take a single. WEST INDIES END WITH 180/7!
SIX! That is clobbered! Full delivery on middle, Pollard lofts it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Pollard lets it go.
Full on middle, Pollard drives it to mid on.
WIDE! Wide outside off, Pollard lets it go.

NO BALL! OUCH! That was nasty! Bennett bowls a high full toss at Pollard and the huge man is caught by surprise there. Hamish soon apologises for it. High full toss on middle, Pollard misses his heave and copes a blow onto his body. He is immediately down but recovers to resume his innings. FREE HIT COMING UP!
SIX! That is smashed! Short ball on middle, Pollard pulls it over square leg for a maximum.
SIX! Length delivery on off, Pollard looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes over the keeper's head for a maximum.
Back of a length on off, Cottrell guides it through point for a run.
SIX! That is hammered! Full ball on off, Pollard lofts it over long off for a biggie.

FOUR! Smashed! FIFTY FOR POLLARD! Amid the collapse, he has stood like a wall there. West Indies would be boosted with the way he is going about his game at the moment. Santner goes short and on middle, Pollard hangs on the back foot and muscles the pull through mid-wicket to get to his milestone.
Loopy ball on off, Pollard plays it to mid off.
NO BALL! Santner oversteps! Floated on middle, Pollard pushes it to mid on.
Full delivery on middle, Pollard flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short delivery on middle, Pollard pulls it through mid-wicket but does not take the run.
Tossed up delivery on off, Pollard defends it out.
Length delivery on off, Cottrell keeps it out.
Sheldon Cottrell is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! THERE IT IS! The 5-wicket haul for Lockie Feguson. He certainly has that X-factor in him. The way he has bowled, even the best in business have failed to find answers to his trick. Keemo Paul too does not have any answer. Ferguson bowls a length ball around off, he gets the ball to rear up off the surface. Paul, who is looking to defend it off the back foot, is caught by surprise seeing the bounce. The ball takes the shoulder of the bat and lobs towards Seifert who takes a dolly.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Paul lets it go. It goes towards the keeper where Seifert gets a hand to it. The batsmen get two byes.
Back of a length on off, Paul keeps it out.
Keemo Paul is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Short of a length ball on middle, Allen looks to pull but gets an outside edge. It goes towards the keeper where Seifert takes a good catch. The bowler asks the umpire and he raises the finger. Allen does not review it as he knew he has nicked it.
FOUR! Full ball on off, Allen lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
SIX! Short delivery on middle, Allen looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes over the keeper's head towards fine leg for a maximum.
Length delivery on off, Allen guides it through point for a single.
Outside off, Allen leaves it alone.
Back of a length on off, Allen looks to slash but misses it. It goes safely towards the keeper.
Short delivery outside off, Allen looks to guide but misses it.
Bouncer on middle, Allen ducks under it.
Short delivery on middle, Pollard pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on middle, Pollard pulls it through square leg for a single. 6,6,4,6,0,1 is what Pollard did against Neesham. 23 from the over.
PLAY AND A MISS! Short of a length and outside off, Pollard looks to pull but misses it.
SIX! That is smashed! Full on middle, Pollard lofts it over long on for a maximum.
FOUR! Full delivery on middle, Pollard flicks it over square leg for a boundary.
SIX! Short delivery on middle, Pollard looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes over the keeper's head for a maximum.
SIX! That is put away! Short ball on middle, Pollard pulls it over square leg for a maximum.
James Neesham is into the attack.
EDGED AND FOUR! Short and wide from Santner there. Allen cuts it only to get a thick outside edge and the ball races to the third man fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and on the pads, Allen just about manages to get some bat on the ball as it tickles fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
Floated on off, blocked off the front foot this time by Allen.

That's sloppy fielding! An extra run given! Floated on off, Allen tucks it to mid-wicket and takes a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end where he misses it. The bowler fails to back it up as the ball goes to covers. The batsmen get a couple.
Shorter and on middle, Pollard tucks it to the leg side and crosses ends with Allen.
Tossed up on middle, tucked to square leg for a single.

We are again set to resume. The New Zealand players are back on the field. Kieron Pollard and Fabian Allen will resume their innings. Mitchell Santner will start the proceedings after the rain break. The game is reduced to 16-overs per side.

2051 local - We are close to resumption as the covers are off. The umpires are taking a look at the ground conditions as of now. Some mopping up work going on by the groundstaff. Not far away from the action to resume. The match will resume at 2100 local.

2035 local - Third stoppage as rain returns at Eden Park. A tough day for groundstaff today. This looks a bit heavier than the previous two rain delays. It is dark too and means that we are in for some more rain before it eases out. How long will this stoppage last as there is some wind too blowing out there? Stay tuned for the updates.
Short of a length ball on off, Kieron hops and keeps it out on the pitch this time.
Slower short ball on off, Allen guides it through third man for a single.
Full on the pads, Pollard flicks it through square leg and crosses for a run.
Short on middle, Pollard drops his wrists as he lets it sail through to the keeper.
Full and on off, Allen taps it to the off side and gets to the other end.
WIDE! Jamieson strays once again in line and bowls it down the leg side only for the umpire to stretch his arms wide open.
Length ball on off, blocked watchfully to the leg side for a run.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side, wide given.
Back of a length on off, Allen keeps it out.
Full on middle, Pollard flicks it through square leg for a run.

NOT OUT! Pollard is safe! Short delivery on middle, Pollard comes forward and looks to fend it but gets it off the shoulder. It goes towards fine leg. The batters take the first run and go for the second. The fielder throws it at the keeper's end where Seifert takes the bails off. It is referred upstairs. Replays show that Pollard made it in time.
An appeal for run out! Pollard is the man in question. Replays show that he has made it safely inside the crease.
Bennett bowls a bouncer, Pollard does well to duck under it.
SIX! That is huge! Full delivery on off, Pollard lofts it over long off for a maximum.

NOT OUT! An inside edge saves the West Indian skipper! Full and on off, Pollard looks to go over the leg side but misses it to get struck on the pads. The bowler and his teammates appeal only for the umpire to raise his finger in their favour. Pollard takes it upstairs and the replays roll in. It is a fair delivery as we move on to the front on spin vision. Looks to be an edge there when the ball is near the bat. Yes, the Ultra Edge confirms it and Pollard survives.
An appeal for lbw! Kieron Pollard is the man in question. He reviews it!
Hamish Bennett is back on.
Another short one around leg, Allen lets it be this time. A dot to end the over.
BEATEN! Full and wide outside off, Allen looks to go over covers but manages to connect it with thin air only.
FOUR LEG BYES!  Ferguson bangs it short and on middle, Allen looking to duck it is late in reacting as the ball takes the shoulder and flies over the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Powerfully struck! Short and wide outside off, Allen cuts it through backward point and past the third man fielder's dive for boundary.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Allen looks to cut it but gets beaten all ends up.
EDGED BUT SHORT OF TAYLOR! Full and on off, Allen looks to defend it off the back foot but gets an outside edge which flies towards Taylor at slips but it drops short of him there.
FOUR! Good shot! Full on middle, Pollard lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on middle, Pollard flicks it through square leg for a couple.
EDGED AND FOUR! Nicely played! Back of a length on off, Pollard looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes wide of the slip fielder towards third man for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Pollard keeps it out.
Full ball on middle, Pollard flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length delivery on middle, Allen pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Lockie Ferguson bowls a bouncer, Pollard does well to duck under it. WEST INDIES ARE 60/5 AFTER 6 OVERS!
Short delivery on middle, Pollard looks to fend at it but gets hit on the hand.
Length delivery on middle, Allen flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Allen looks to defend but misses it.
Length ball on off, Allen keeps it out.
Fabian Allen is the new batsman in. He will face the hat-trick ball from Ferguson.

OUT! LBW!  Oh my what did you have for lunch, Lockie? It is all going New Zealand's way at the moment. Typical West Indies innings. 58 for no loss to 59 for 5! Ferguson goes full and around middle, he gets the ball to nip back into the batsman. Pooran looks to defend it without any footwork there. He misses the line of the delivery and gets rapped on the pad. There is an appeal from the bowler and the keeper and the umpire raises his finger. Pooran though is not happy as he takes it upstairs, The replays roll in and it is a legal delivery. No edge as the Ultra Edge confirms. Ball Tracker comes in and shows impact as umpire's call. Pooran has to walk back.

REVIEW TIME! Player review for LBW! The on field decision is out! Lets see what the replays show.  It is a legal delivery. It does not look there is an edge on it to the naked eye. Ultra Edge confirms it. Onto the Ball Tracker now. Impact Umpire's call, pitching in line and hitting the wickets. Pooran has to take the long walk back.
Length delivery on off, Pooran guides it through point for a run.
Kieron Pollard is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Southee gets his second and West Indies are in a spot of bother here! Short of a length delivery, Powell looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes towards square leg where Lockie Ferguson takes a good catch.
Back of a length and outside off, Powell looks to defend but misses it.
Length ball on off, Powell keeps it out.
Rovman Powell is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Southee now joins the party! West Indies losing the plot here as they are three down in quick time. Short and wide outside off, King slashes at it hard and the ball flies to the third man fence where Neesham takes it with ease.
Length delivery on off, King defends it out.
Nicholas Pooran is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Ferguson on fire! One brings two and Lockie has the big hitter Hetmyer. Length ball around middle, Hetmyer makes room to go over the off side. Ferguson is smart as he follows him. Shimron still goes with the shot and manages to get an outside edge which is taken comfortably by Seifert behind the wickets.
Length ball on off, Hetmyer plays it to point.
Length delivery on off, Shimron blocks it well.
Back of a length on off, Hetmyer keeps it out.
Shimron Hetmyer with the bat now.

OUT! BOWLED! A wicket against the run of play! New Zealand and Ferguson are elated! He bowls one on a length and gets it to nip into the batter, Fletcher once again looks to go downtown but is beaten to see his stumps shattered. Southee will be relieved to see the back of Fletcher.
Length delivery on off, King punches it through covers. The batsmen get three runs.
Lockie Ferguson is into the attack.
FOUR! Hammered! Full use of the free hit from Fletcher there. Full and on off, Fletcher clobbers it over covers and fetches a boundary.
NO BALL AND FOUR! Bennett oversteps this time! Hammered! 50 up for West Indies in no time. Full and on off, Fletcher lofts it over covers and fetches a boundary. FREE HIT AGAIN!
NO BALL! A high full toss from Hamish, King somehow manages to fend it away to the leg side. FREE HIT COMING UP! The batsmen take a run too.
Short and on off, Fletcher pulls it to deep square leg for a single.

SIX! SWEET SOUND OF THE BAT THERE! Short and on middle, Fletcher hooks it powerfully and the ball sails over deep mid-wicket. It goes high and long over the fence this time. It is the longest part of the boundary.
Length ball on middle, King turns it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! CRACKED! Full and straight on off, King hammers it straight down the ground past mid on and into the fence at long on.

FOUR WIDES! That went through Seifert's gloves! Bennett bangs it short and down the leg side, King looks to hook it but misses it. The vicious bounce on it surprised Seifert behind as he is late to react. The ball goes to the third man fence. Wide signalled.
Full and around off, Fletcher taps it to point and hares for a quick single.
1945 local - Play resumes! New Zealand players are back on the field. Andre Fletcher and Brandon King will resume their innings. Hamish Bennett will start the proceedings after the rain break.

1932 local - Ohh! Another stoppage and the rain is playing hide and seek with us here. The players are once again going back to the dugout. This time though 8 balls were possible before the rain came. Let's hope that we don't have any further stoppage as the sun makes it presence felt from behind the clouds. Encouraging signs for all the New Zealand and West Indies supporters along with cricket fans across the world. There is no sign of rain for the remaining part of this match. Let us hope we get a full game from now on!
FOUR! King joins the party now! Short and around middle, King pulls it handsomely as the ball goes towards the long on fence for a boundary. 18 runs off the over.
Full and around off, King looks to play it on the up but gets beaten on the outside edge comprehensively.
Length and outside off, Andre pushes it to point and takes off for a quick single, The fielder there has a shy at the keeper's end but misses it.
SIX! That's even better! Short and wide outside off, Fletcher cuts it uppishly over point and gets a biggie as the ball goes 10 rows back over the ropes.
SIX! BANGED! Full and around off, Fletcher lofts it over the bowler's head and gets a maximum at long on.
WIDE! Kyle bowls one down the leg side and it is wided by the umpire.
Lovely start from Jamieson! Bowls it around off and gets a good bounce too. Fletcher looks to defend it off the back foot but gets hit high on the thigh pad.
Kyle Jamieson to bowl from the other end.
Length ball on off, King drives it beautifully only to find the fielder at covers.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side, King looks to flick it but misses it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
On a good length and on off, King blocks it off the back foot.
1923 local - The New Zealand players get back on field as they are followed by the unbeaten pair of King and Fletcher. Southee to complete his over.

1915 local (1815 GMT) - Resumption in a short while as the covers are coming off. All the fans would hope that the rain stays away for now so that the game can be enjoyed. The groundstaff are mopping up the outfield now as there are traces of water on it. Not far away as we get the action back on. Looking at the overhead conditions it doesn't seem that the rain will stay away as the sky has gone pitch black. If not a washout it should be a stop-start affair.

Oh! Just 4 balls into the game and the heavens have opened up. It is drizzling heavily now. The covers have been brought on. We hope that the stoppage is not a long one and we get a complete game! Fingers crossed at the moment. Nevertheless New Zealand has a history of washouts and we hope it is not this time as the action resumes after a long time. Stay tuned with us as we bring you all the updates.
Length ball on the pads, Andre flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! First runs off the bat! Short and wide outside off, Fletcher stays on the back foot and cuts it powerfully through point for the first boundary.
Outside off, left alone this time by Andre.
SWING AND A MISS! Length ball outside off, Fletcher goes for the cut but gets beaten.
WIDE! Once again Southee goes down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
WIDE! False start from Southee as West Indies are underway! Tim slides one down the leg side and it is called a wide.

We are done and dusted with the national anthems. We are all set to begin. The New Zealand players are out in the middle. Brandon King and Andre Fletcher will open the innings for West Indies. Tim Southee will start the proceedings for New Zealand.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Brandon King, Andre Fletcher, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Rovman Powell, Kieron Pollard (C), Fabian Allen, Keemo Paul, Sheldon Cottrell, Kesrick Williams, Oshane Thomas.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Tim Seifert (WK), Devon Conway (DEBUT), Glenn Phillips, Ross Taylor, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee (C), Kyle Jamieson (DEBUT), Lockie Ferguson, Hamish Bennett.

PITCH REPORT- It is a nice pitch with a green tinge which will keep the bowlers interested. Ian Bishop says that the ball might stick into the surface. He mentions that the bowlers should make sure that they do not get hit down the ground as the dimensions are small.

West Indies skipper, Kieron Pollard says that the toss is always a 50-50 chance. He says that they will look to bat well. Also says that the series is important and they would look to come out and play their best game. He says that playing against the crowd is what they are accustomed to.

New Zealand skipper, Tim Southee starts by saying that they will field first as it a chasing ground. He also says that they are excited to get back to playing cricket after a long layoff. Ends by saying that playing in front of crowd would be an added factor. Mentions there are two debutants for them today, Devon Conway and Kyle Jamieson.

TOSS - It's time to give a flip to the coin. The two skippers, Kieron Pollard and Tim Southee are out in the middle alongwith the match referee. Up she goes and it lands in favour of Tim Southee. NEW ZEALAND ELECT TO FIELD FIRST!

Australia vs India has begun, South Africa vs England is yet to begin and in between that New Zealand start their home series against West Indies with the T20Is. Hello and welcome to the coverage of the 1st of the 3 T20Is. West Indies led by Kieron Pollard take on the Kiwis who are being led by Tim Southee. Under Kieron Pollard the team would look to perform well as they are well tuned in this format playing a lot of franchise cricket. New Zealand's record is dismal and they would look to change that for sure. Lack of match practice could be a factor here for Kiwis. Let's see who prevails today? Men in Maroon or the Black Caps? Stay tuned for toss and team updates.
